prompt_md: **Transfer:** an English-only embedding model is used on Hindi support tickets. What do you expect, and what do you do?

options.md: Poor retrieval: the model never learned Hindi. Evaluate multilingual models on labelled Hindi queries

options.why_md: Embeddings capture what the model was trained on.
Normalization doesn't teach a model a language.

hints: Which idea applies? Choose an embedding model by language and domain, max input, dimensions and cost.
